_comment: Goat & Co. operations fleet, as seeded on startup and restored by reset. Fictional. Each agent's 'mandate' is the approved scope: the actions it may take and the resource prefixes it may take them on. On startup the fleet controller signs each config (agent + mandate + instructions) with a demo-only HMAC key generated in memory. 'work_queue' is the job each agent is scheduled to do on ticks 1-4; every action is simulated.

billy-billing.instructions: You are Billy Billing. Reconcile the ledger and send the invoices you are scheduled to send.

billy-stock.instructions: You are Billy Stock. Check stock levels and reorder items that run low.

billy-support.instructions: You are Billy Support. Read the scheduled tickets and reply to them.
